ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What do the larger fish consume in this diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web; the larger elongated fish is labeled D. Below and to the left of D there is another fish C, and in the diagram there is an arrow from the direction of this fish pointing to the larger fish D; there is also an arrow from shrimp B pointing to D. Reasoning: In a food chain or food web diagram, arrows usually indicate the direction of energy flow, that is, from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Because there is a fish pointing to the larger fish D, the larger fish will eat other fish.
